title: Kyverna ‘resetting conversation’ with 1-year miv-cel data as autoimmune CAR-T peers hit safety snags
summary: As two Big Pharma players in the autoimmune CAR-T space face unexpected safety setbacks, Kyverna Therapeutics is reporting long-term clinical data that showcase sustained efficacy alongside an unblemished safety profile for its potential first-in-class candidate, miv-cel.

title: Lilly puts up $100M, plus billions on the backend, to form 5-target deal with China's InnoCare
summary: Eli Lilly has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to InnoCare Pharma to form a five-target drug discovery pact. The deal features up to $3.25 billion in milestones.

title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop
summary: Immunovant has stopped development of IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus after failing a midphase test, closing off one path to market for the anti-FcRn antibody.

title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has dived deeper into its collaboration with Variant Bio by expanding the collaboration to cover cardiovascular disease to the tune of $250 million.

title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

title: Anaconda Biomed snares $56M in funding for endovascular tech
summary: Medtech startup Anaconda Biomed has hauled in $53 million to help finish off work on a pivotal trial for its endovascular project.

title: Novartis secures new radioligand in $900M deal as competition strengthens
summary: As an imposing new competitor begins to take shape, radiopharma leader Novartis has beefed up its pipeline by licensing a preclinical radioligand therapy from a specialist Chinese biotech.

title: Celldex monoclonal antibody rebounds with pair of phase 3 wins for chronic skin condition
summary: Celldex touted a double phase 3 trial win in patients with treatment-refractory chronic spontaneous urticaria.

title: Amgen’s Horizon-acquired fusion protein eases Sjögren's severity in ph. 3 win
summary: An investigational drug for the autoimmune condition Sjögren's disease has scored a phase 3 win for Amgen, marking a positive sign for the Horizon Therapeutics-acquired pipeline that has so far struggled to gain traction.

title: Vertex’s midstage data amplify kidney disease market opportunity
summary: Vertex has reported positive phase 2b data for its kidney disease prospect inaxaplin, boosting its efforts to expand beyond the population targeted in a pivotal trial.

title: Lexeo takes up the Mantle in $8M acquisition for Friedreich ataxia assets

title: Otsuka heads to FDA as Ionis-partnered ALS drug hits primary phase 3 endpoint

title: Novo CEO sees advantages in souping up NYSE listing: report

title: Par Health recalls IV sedative in US, flagging presence of cellulose, stopper material
